basis: Skin/nail, oral and marrow disease define DC; cellular immunodeficiency 30-79%; cap excludes frequent neurologic, renal, skeletal and airway abnormalities.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: oral leukoplakia is part of the defining triad and occurs in 80-99%; esophageal stenosis and dental disease occur in 30-79%.
decisions.infectious_immune: involved: cellular immunodeficiency occurs in 30-79%; it is associated immune dysfunction rather than the defining mechanism of this telomere disorder.

basis: Inherited deglycosylation defects; developmental impairment and central neurologic dysfunction affect most (>80%) reported patients across subtypes.

decisions.neurologic: involved: neurodevelopmental impairment affects most (>80%) reported patients across subtypes; it is a consequence of the defining metabolic defect.

basis: Patellar aplasia/hypoplasia and microtia define the syndrome; microcephaly alone does not establish neurologic dysfunction; developmental delays are only 5-29%.

decisions.neurologic: none: microcephaly in 2/3 does not establish brain dysfunction; motor and language delays occur in only 5-29%.

basis: Direct peripheral nerve injury defines diabetic polyneuropathy; diabetes is the separately diagnosed underlying metabolic disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: this concept denotes peripheral nerve damage; the causative diabetes is a separate metabolic disease.

basis: Defining limb, hearing and pigmentary defects; structural blepharophimosis 80-99%; atelectasis 30-79% omitted by cap; iris pigmentation alone is non-damaging.

decisions.pulmonary: none: atelectasis is reported in 30-79%, but more frequent structural eyelid involvement takes the fourth organ slot.
decisions.ocular: involved: structural blepharophimosis occurs in 80-99%; this supports eyelid involvement independently of harmless iris pigmentation.

basis: Endocrine pancreatic tumor with defining WDHA syndrome: sustained intestinal secretory dysfunction, reduced gastric acid secretion and hypokalemia.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: intestinal hypersecretion and gastric acid suppression are defining functional abnormalities of WDHA syndrome, not merely incidental diarrhea.

basis: Craniosynostosis and ocular/eyelid malformations characterize the syndrome; developmental impairment and cardiac defects lack established frequencies.

decisions.neurologic: none: developmental delay and intellectual disability have unspecified frequencies and are not established major diagnostic criteria in the supplied evidence.

basis: Partial gonadal dysgenesis impairs testicular endocrine development; congenital heart disease is a named syndrome component, with tetralogy of Fallot in 1/3.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: congenital heart disease is explicitly a named syndrome component; tetralogy of Fallot occurs in 1/3 reported patients.

basis: HHV8-associated vascular endothelial sarcoma predominantly arising in skin; vascular origin supports cardiovascular; visceral involvement varies across endemic forms.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: Kaposi sarcoma is a vascular endothelial malignancy, classified here under angiosarcoma; vessels are an explicit cardiovascular-axis tissue.

basis: CD79A-related B-cell maturation arrest with absent circulating B cells and antibodies; recurrent respiratory and ear infections are separately diagnosed diseases.

decisions.haematologic: primary: absent circulating B cells (1/1) reflect the defining B-cell maturation defect, a blood-cell disease; inclusion does not depend on nonspecific neutropenia.
